'''''Fate of the Jedi: Conviction''''' by [[Aaron Allston]] is the seventh novel in the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series and was released on [[May 24]], [[2011]]. At the end of the book, it has an introduction to ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''. The audio version is narrated by [[Marc Thompson]]. The paperback was released on [[August 28]], [[2012]].
